chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, and Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Al-Hakam Al-A'ma and Hisham ibn Salim, from Ammar Al-Sabati, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding a man who said to another man, 'O son of the fornicator,' meaning adultery. He (peace be upon him) said: 'If his mother was alive and present, then she came seeking her right, he would be whipped eighty lashes; and if she was absent, he would be awaited with her until she arrives so she seeks her right; and if she had died and nothing was known about her except for goodness, the fabricator upon her would be whipped the limit, eighty lashes.'

key_terms.الْفَاعِلَةِ: The fornicator (female), used in the phrase 'son of the fornicator'
key_terms.الْمُفْتَرِي: The fabricator (one who makes a false accusation)

ai.seo_question: What is the hadd punishment for calling someone 'son of the fornicator' and how does the mother's status affect it?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi details the application of the hadd for qadhf (slander) when accusing a man of being the son of a fornicator, emphasizing the mother's role as the key witness to her own honor. It establishes a procedural nuance where the punishment is immediate if she is present, delayed if absent to ensure her testimony, and still applied if she has died with a known reputation for chastity, reflecting the Shia juristic focus on the preservation of lineage and honor.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Al Hakam Al A’ama and Hisham Bin Salim, from Ammar Al Sabaty,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding a man who said to a man, ‘O son of the done with’, meaning the adultery. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If his mother was alive, present, then she came seeking her right, he would be whipped eighty lashes; and if she was absent, she would be awaited with until she proceeds, so she seeks her right; and if she had died and nothing was known about her except for the goodness, the fabricator, upon him would be eighty lashes’.
